posts.texte: We’re officially in the GTA 6 launch week.

GTA VI reviewers had to request maps from Rockstar multiple times

The game's vast map made it difficult to inspect every area

GTA 6 details you probably missed from the previews and Extended Look:

- Jason and Lucia will get bags under their eyes if they don’t sleep enough
- If they don’t sleep for a couple of days, the regens of stamina and health won’t be as quick but the walking gait won’t be

GTA 6 is featured on this week’s Famitsu magazine, who previously released a preview in August.

It releases on November 19, featuring 32 pages, a breakdown of the game and a look at the history of Rockstar.
GTA 6 is officially 72 hours away from launch.
